mapper.select: select ADD_ID as addId, sum(IF(DICT_TYPE = '1' and ITEM_TYPE = '税前',REAL_AMOUNT,0)) as addAmount, sum(IF(DICT_TYPE = '1' and ITEM_TYPE = '税后',REAL_AMOUNT,0)) as lastAddAmount, sum(IF(DICT_TYPE = '2' and ITEM_TYPE = '税前',REAL_AMOUNT,0)) as minusAmount, sum(IF(DICT_TYPE = '2' and ITEM_TYPE = '税后',REAL_AMOUNT,0)) as lastMinusAmount from HR_SALARY_ADD_RECORD where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and ADD_ID = #{addId} group by ADD_ID

select a.*, c.`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth,c.ID_CARD_NUMBER as idCardNumber,c.USER_NAME as userName, c.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName,c.ORG_NAME as orgName,c.COMPANY as company from HR_SALARY_ADD_RECORD a left join HR_SALARY_ADD b on a.ADD_ID = b.ID left join HR_SALARY_STANDARD c on b.STANDARD_ID = c.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.*, c.`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth,c.ID_CARD_NUMBER as idCardNumber,c.USER_NAME as userName, c.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName,c.ORG_NAME as orgName,c.COMPANY as company from HR_SALARY_ADD_RECORD a left join HR_SALARY_ADD b on a.ADD_ID = b.ID left join HR_SALARY_STANDARD c on b.STANDARD_ID = c.ID where a.ID = #{id}
